items.title: Six Liangmai Naga civilians laid to rest in Manipur 187 days after abduction, killing
items.text: United Naga Council president N.G. Lorho said May 13, 2026, would remain the darkest day in Manipur’s history

items.title: Bilkis Bano case: Supreme Court suspends sentence, grants bail to two convicts
items.text: The order published on the court website reasoned that the two men had already been imprisoned for more than 17 years and one of them suffers a severe handicap

items.title: Export duty on diesel hiked ₹2.5/litre, ATF ₹1.5/litre, petrol remains nil
items.text: The hike in diesel levy assumes added significance as India looks to further up their exports of the vehicular fuel to Europe amid a global supply crunch.

items.title: IBM investing $3 billion annually in India, plans $10 bn global quantum push: CEO
items.text: Chairman and Chief Executive Arvind Krishna said AI could displace 10-20% of jobs over the next decade, with the BPO industry likely to face some of the biggest reductions

items.title: Telangana teachers question order linking leave to 95% school attendance
items.text: Hyderabad Collector Priyanka Ala has made prior approval mandatory for teachers seeking leave until schools achieve 95% attendance, prompting teacher representatives to question the legality of the directive.
